CalibrationService

class CalibrationService(dao=None, dao_calibration_point=None, calibration_setting_service=None)[source]

Bases: object

Business logic of the projection and camera calibration.

Parameters:
daoCalibrationIniDAO | None, optional

DAO of the hardware calibration. Default is None, which creates a new CalibrationIniDAO.

dao_calibration_pointCalibrationPointCsvDAO | None, optional

DAO of the calibration points. Default is None, which creates a new CalibrationPointCsvDAO.

calibration_setting_serviceCalibrationSettingService, optional

Settings service to reuse. Default is None, which creates one on first use.

Attributes:
daoCalibrationIniDAO

DAO of the hardware calibration.

dao_calibration_pointCalibrationPointCsvDAO

DAO of the calibration points.

Notes

The get_mediapipe_*, get_opencv_*, get_filter_*, is_* and calibration-mode getters only delegate to CalibrationSettingService.
